senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; צָלַל , v. טְלָלָא) shade, shadow; protection.
units: <cite ref="Sukkah 2a:8-9">Succ. 2ᵃ</cite> <he>עד … אדם יושב בצל סוכה</he> up to a height (of the walls) of twenty cubits one sits in the shade of the ceiling of the booth; <he>למעלה … בצל רפנות</he> above twenty cubits, one sits no longer shaded by the ceiling, but shaded by the walls. Ib.ᵇ <he>כיון דרויחא איכא צל סוכה</he> when the Succah is very large, there is the shade of the ceiling (even when the walls are higher than twenty cubits).

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 1:2:1">Koh. R. to I, 2</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 6:12:1">ib. VI, 12</cite>) <he>כאיזה צל אם כצִלּוֹ של כותל וכ׳</he> like what shadow? if like the shadow of a wall, there is some reality in it; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 6:12:1">ib.</cite> <he>כצִלָּן של דבורים וכ׳</he> like the shadow cast by flying bees &c.; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 96:2">Gen. R. s. 96</cite> <he>כצִילּוֹ וכ׳</he>.
<cite ref="Pesachim 114a:2">Pes. 114ᵃ</cite> <he>אכול בָּצֵל ושב בַּצֵּל וכ׳</he> eat onions and sit in the shade (of thy house in contentment) rather than &c.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 3:11:2">Y. Ab. Zar. III, 43ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>צִיּלָּהּ אסור צל צילה מותר</he> the shade of a worshipped tree is forbidden (to be enjoyed), the shade of the shade is permitted; <he>כל שאילן … זהו צילה וכ׳</he> as far as the tree would reach if felled, so far is its shadow; what is beyond, is the shadow of the shadow; Bab.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 48b">Ab. Zar. 48ᵇ</cite> <he>צל קומתה</he> the extent of the shadow corresponding to the height of the tree. Midr. Sam. ch. XIV; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 109:1">Yalk. Sam. 109</cite>, v. <cite ref="R00266"><he>צַח</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 34:1">Ex. R. s. 34</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 91:1">Ps. XCI, 1</cite>) <he>בצל שעשה בצלאל</he> in the shade which Bezalel has made (the Tabernacle).
<cite ref="Berakhot 55a:12">Ber. 55ᵃ</cite> (play on <cite ref="B01096"><he>בצלאל</he></cite>) <he>שמא בצל אל היית וכ׳</he> hast thou been in the shade of God that thou knowest it?; a. v. fr.
